summary: WAYLOAM v0.4.2.alpha adds real router-generated maneuver guidance and hardens camps, water, food and bicycle-service discovery for long-distance routes.
highlights: Ride now shows real BRouter-derived turn, keep, exit and roundabout maneuvers with distance to the next instruction.
Long-route service discovery is chunked across the corridor with public Overpass fallback and partial-success retention.
Water, camps, shelters, food and bicycle services cover a broader set of useful OpenStreetMap tags.
Planner and Ride expose loaded POI counts and a Retry stops action when route-service discovery genuinely fails.
added: Typed graph-derived maneuver data from the pinned WAYLOAM Router build.
Next-maneuver instruction and distance in Ride mode.
Loaded POI counts in map-layer controls.
Retryable route-service failure state in Planner and Ride.
Broader expedition POI coverage including huts, cafés, restaurants, bakeries, greengrocers and marketplaces.
changed: Nearby-service discovery queries long routes in overlapping chunks instead of one large Overpass request.
Transient Overpass failures fall back across public endpoints and successful chunks are preserved.
Maneuvers are stitched and cached with long routes so navigation guidance survives cache reuse and app restarts.
fixed: A temporary POI-service outage no longer appears to the rider as a route with zero camps, water or shops.
Planner now passes real per-category POI counts to the map-layer menu just like Ride.
Stale route-cache artifacts are removed by explicit router cache clearing.
The pinned router Android instrumentation suite is green on API 36.
